title: Catch Every New Lead in One Sweep
summary: Check every inbox and DM channel for new leads on a schedule, sort them, and get a draft follow-up for each one, so no lead goes cold because it landed in the wrong place.

money_potential.label: Medium
money_potential.basis: Assumes leads already reach you in several places; the value is answering more of them while they are warm.
money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: More leads answered while they are still warm.
Fewer leads lost in a second inbox or a DM.
who_its_for: Small businesses with leads arriving in several places.
Freelancers and agencies who forget to follow up.

steps: Connect every inbox and DM channel where leads arrive.
Run a sweep and sort what came in.
Send the ones you like and log the rest.
guardrails: Nothing sends until you hit send.
Keep inbox access read-only where you can.
